ns2:course.label: Soc Impacts Weather & Climate
ns2:course.description: Examines the interconnectedness of weather, climate and society. Focus is on the complex relationship between weather, climate and society from both a physical and social perspective with an examination of the role of sustainability in both impacts and future mitigation. Discussions focused on the physical principles driving the weather and climate and how they interact with all aspects of society. Same as ENSU 301.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BSLAS: Atmospheric Sci -UIUC, BSLAS: Earth Sys,Env,Soc -UIUC, BSLAS: Earth, Soc,& Env - UIUC, or BSLAS: Earth,Soc,Env Sust-UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
